reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Meaning of "person"
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: defines 'person' broadly to include natural persons, business entities, common law trusts, building owners/lessees/keepers, agents, and building contractors.

headings.title: Meaning of "minor repairs" and exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to note exclusions. Verified sub 2: covers listed interior leak/pipe/fixture repairs but excludes connections to soil/supply/waste/vent/inside rain leader pipes, replacing or setting fixtures, and work the supervisor judges a public-health risk if improperly done.

headings.title: Meaning of "apprentice"
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: defines 'apprentice' as a person learning plumbing and drainage installation under the personal direction and supervision of a licensed master or journeyman plumber.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 341.090 (bid 18345), all three subsections, and source note (L. 1943 p. 831 § 15). Retained subs 1 and 3 titles; revised sub 2 from 'Meaning of "minor repairs"' to 'Meaning of "minor repairs" and exclusions' to reflect substantial statutory exclusions and supervisor public-health judgment.

headings.title: Master plumber applicant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: minimum age 25, 3+ years as a licensed journeyman plumber under §§ 341.090-341.220 or equivalent county/city rules, plus supervisory, design, installation, and public-health knowledge.

headings.title: Journeyman plumber applicant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: minimum age 21, 5+ years as an apprentice under a master plumber licensed under §§ 341.090-341.220 or equivalent local rules, plus practical skill and knowledge.

headings.title: Master drainlayer applicant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: minimum age 25, 3+ years as a licensed journeyman drainlayer under equivalent county/city rules, plus supervisory, design, and drainlaying skill/knowledge.

headings.title: Journeyman drainlayer applicant qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: 1+ year supervised drainlaying work under a licensed master plumber or master drainlayer, plus sewer/drain installation knowledge; no minimum age specified.

headings.title: Drainlayer license required for plumbers
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to reflect mandatory rule. Verified sub 5: licensed master or journeyman plumbers may not engage in drainlaying without first securing a drainlayer's license.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 341.170 (bid 18353), all five subsections, and source note (L. 1943 p. 831 § 5). Noted catchline-vs-body mismatch: catchline mentions only master plumber qualifications, whereas body also covers journeyman plumbers, master/journeyman drainlayers, and drainlayer licensure for plumbers. Revised sub 5 from 'Drainlayer license for plumbers' to 'Drainlayer license required for plumbers' to reflect the mandatory prohibition.

headings.title: Surety bonds for master plumbers and master drainlayers
headings.reviewNote: Clarified title to specify both master categories. Verified sub 1: $2,000 bond with one licensed corporate surety filed with the supervisor before licensure, approved by county counselor, with compliance, indemnity, and licensed-journeyman employment conditions under §§ 341.090-341.220.

headings.title: License display, drainlayer limits, and misrepresentation
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to include drainlayer interior-plumbing prohibition. Verified sub 2: duty to show license on demand to department inspectors, bar on drainlayer licensees doing interior building plumbing work, and bar on representing oneself as licensed without a §§ 341.090-341.220 license.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 341.200 (bid 18356), both subsections, and source note (L. 1943 p. 831 § 8). Noted catchline-vs-body mismatch: catchline mentions only surety bonds, whereas sub 2 governs license display, interior plumbing prohibition for drainlayers, and unlawful unlicensed representation. Revised both titles for precision and completeness.
